label: P1 of the definitional argument: the description 'existing, GOD_4, omnibenevolent' has been defined
paraphrase: Analyst formulation of the owner-specified premise 'I define the existing omnibenevolent God' (attribution deferred): in a definitional frame, the description 'an existing object that is God and is omnibenevolent' has been introduced by a definitional act. 'Existing' is the frame's existence predicate, which marks the objects that are among the beings the root's God-exists claim quantifies over; 'defined' means introduced by stipulation, nothing more. The statement says only that the definition was made, not that anything satisfies it.
